doc.title: Character.AI faces licensing suit from publisher over chatbot replies
doc.body: A publisher sued the chatbot company on Tuesday, alleging that its models reproduced licensed article text in replies. The filing asks for an injunction covering the model's retrieval layer; the company said it will contest the claim and that its training corpus is licensed.

doc.title: Court lets authors pursue training-data claims against Meta's torrent corpus
doc.body: The judge narrowed the claims but kept the core allegation that the lab seeded a torrent swarm to obtain books for pretraining. Discovery on model checkpoints continues; the lab argues the corpus was downloaded by contractors.

doc.title: New licensing rule trims accelerator imports at two AI labs' regional data centres
doc.body: The commerce ministry published a licensing list that caps import volumes for high-end accelerators at the two data centres the labs use for pretraining. Both labs said scheduled training runs continue and that they are re-planning capacity for the next quarter.

doc.title: Regulator opens first general-purpose model review under the AI Act
doc.body: The AI office sent questionnaires to three model providers asking for training-data summaries, evaluation results and incident logs. Providers have ten weeks to answer; non-compliance can trigger fines and a market-withdrawal order for the affected model family.

doc.title: Tribunal suspends a city's AI triage contract award pending review
doc.body: The review board paused the award after a losing bidder challenged the evaluation of the model's accuracy figures. The city must re-score the two finalists within 30 days; the vendor said deployment of the pilot is unaffected.

doc.title: Anthropic ships a spreadsheet add-in for enterprise Claude deployments
doc.body: The add-in lets finance teams call the model from inside a workbook, with row-level permissions and an audit log per call. Pricing follows seat count, not token volume. Analysts called it a quieter bet than the coding agent, and the company said the add-in reuses the same context windows as its desktop app. A commentary note compared the rollout to earlier 总书记 site visits — incidental colour, not the item's mainline.
